Microsoft

user Now tell me its most recent quarterly revenue figure. Reply with the number only.

데이터가 오래되었을 수 있으니 확실하지 않으면 그렇다고 말해 주세요.

assistant I don't have a reliable figure to give you. My training data has a cutoff, so I can't know Microsoft's most recent quarterly revenue — and even the last quarter I might have information on could have been superseded by newer reports since then.

For reference, Microsoft's fiscal 2024 (ended June 30, 2024) quarterly revenues were roughly in the $60-65 billion range, with FY2024 Q4 around $64.7 billion. But I'd treat that as approximate, and it's certainly not the "most recent" quarter by now.

For an accurate current number, check Microsoft's investor relations page (microsoft.com/investor) or their latest 10-Q filing with the SEC.
